coverage_override.reason: The Normal/Special Summon trigger and the hand/field Quick Effect with its rewritten operation and HOPT are two activated effects.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Aldrez card from your Deck to the GY. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal and Special Summon trigger clones share one id-keyed count limit, select an eligible Aldrez card from the Deck, and send it to the GY by effect.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a delayed trigger and filtered Deck-to-GY processing under a hard once-per-turn limit.

effects.printed_clause: When the opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect while this card is in your hand or face-up field: Tribute this card; rewrite the effect to send a face-up opposing Xyz to the GY, then Special Summon this card to the opponent negated, and apply the monster-effect lock. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand/MZONE EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect now checks IsReleasable and calls Duel.Release for the handler in either location. It replaces the opponent's chain operation, has that opponent choose and send the qualifying Xyz, Special Summons Clock to their field negated when possible, and independently registers the printed on-field non-Aldrez monster-effect activation lock through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses Duel.ChangeChainOperation to replace an activated effect with a new resolving operation.
Checks IsReleasable and uses Duel.Release for a handler activated from the hand or field.

effects.issue: Fixed: the hand branch now performs a real Tribute with Duel.Release and observes Tribute legality, instead of merely sending the card to the GY with a release reason flag.
